shared_prompt:
Generate ONE entirely NEW independent luxury fashion editorial WEBSITE BANNER, panoramic 3:1 approx2172x724. This is a newly photographed scene, NOT a recolor/edit of an existing banner. Each of three banners needs a different person, outfit, place, background, pose and camera angle.
Reference 1 supplies ONLY this adult model's distinct beautiful face/identity and premium natural skin/hair photograph quality. Do NOT inherit its clothing, pose, room, framing, colors, or casino machines. Reference 2 supplies ONLY the series champagne-gold flowing ribbon/filament language, panoramic copy-left / image-right architecture and photographic finish. Do NOT copy reference 2's person, pose or scene. Reference 3 is the site screenshot: top-row wide banner slot and left copy placement only.
Fixed series elements: premium flattering studio fashion photography, warm-neutral luminous realistic skin, tactile luxury fabric, shallow depth of field, sophisticated champagne GOLD ribbon effects at outer edges, high production polish. Main theme color varies per individual scene.
LEFT 45-48% is quiet low-detail negative space for later title, short sentence and button; no subjects, props or bright highlights there. Blend naturally into the new photographed scene, not a hard rectangular panel. RIGHT 54-94% contains the large upper-body fashion portrait and role-specific props. Entire head clearly inside frame with 7-9% headroom; face readable at 297x101 display. No accidental anatomy or hands over face.
Use TWO controlled sweeping champagne-gold effects, a fine filament near upper edge and a polished gold ribbon/luminous fine lines at bottom and far-right edge. Their curve may adapt to this new pose but belong to the same design family. Do not overpower the photo or left copy space. No bulky ornate frame or copied decorations.
All models clearly adult professionals age24-25, exceptionally beautiful fresh harmonious features and refined confident expressions, fully opaque couture wardrobe. NO TEXT anywhere, no letters, numerals, writing, logos, labels, watermark or readable background signage. Any coins are unmarked. One full panoramic bitmap, no grid or collage.
